Flagpedia country flag icons
============================

Source: https://flagpedia.net/download/icons
Source set update: 2026-02-06

Flagpedia states that its downloadable country flag icon package is
completely free for commercial and non-commercial use and is public domain.
The icons are based on vector files from Wikimedia Commons. Fabulor records
this source and status here because the download does not include a separate
licence file.
